items.label: C1
accept: Daniel kept thinking about his future.

items.label: C2
items.promptEn:
(be, good, at, express)
→ I __________________________ my feelings.
accept: I am good at expressing my feelings.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요. POINT 8·9·10. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.label: C3
items.promptEn:
(avoid, drink, coffee)
→ My grandma __________________________ in the evening.
accept: My grandma avoids drinking coffee in the evening.

items.promptEn:

→ He saved money __________________________.
accept: He saved money by cooking at home.
